import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int)1e9 + 7;
    static long n;
    static int k;
    static List<List<List<Integer>>> pref = new ArrayList<>();

    static int add_mod(int a, int b) {
        int s = a + b;
        if (s >= MOD) s -= MOD;
        return s;
    }

    static int subtract_mod(int a, int b) {
        int s = a - b;
        if (s < 0) s += MOD;
        return s;
    }

    static int multiply_mod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }

    static int[][] matrix_multiply(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int size = k + 1;
        int[][] c = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t <= k; t++) {
                    c[i][t] = add_mod(c[i][t], multiply_mod(a[i][j], b[j][t]));
                }
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static int[][] shift_matrix(int[][] mat) {
        int size = k + 1;
        int[][] c = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                int ni = i;
                if (ni < k) ni = (ni + k - 1) % k;
                int nj = j;
                if (nj < k) nj = (nj + k - 1) % k;
                c[i][j] = mat[ni][nj];
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static void print_matrix(int[][] c) {
        for (int[] row : c) {
            for (int v : row) {
                System.out.print(v + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
        System.out.println("------------");
    }

    static void initialize() {
        long temp = n;
        int digits = 0;
        while (temp > 0) {
            temp /= k;
            digits++;
        }
        pref = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> basePref = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            basePref.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
        }
        // Initialize pref[0]
        List<List<Integer>> pref0 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            pref0.add(new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(k + 1, 0)));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            pref0.get(i).set(i, 1);
        }
        pref0.get(0).set(k, 1);
        pref0.get(k).set(0, subtract_mod(0, 1));
        pref0.get(k).set(k, 2);
        pref.add(pref0);

        for (int step = 0; step < digits; step++) {
            List<List<Integer>> currentPref = pref.get(step);
            List<List<Integer>> nextPref = deepCopy(currentPref);
            for (int i = 1; i <= k - 1; i++) {
                currentPref = shift_matrix(currentPref);
                nextPref = matrix_multiply(nextPref, currentPref);
            }
            pref.add(nextPref);
        }
    }

    static int[][] deepCopy(List<List<Integer>> matrix) {
        int size = matrix.size();
        int[][] copy = new int[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            List<Integer> row = matrix.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                copy[i][j] = row.get(j);
            }
        }
        return copy;
    }

    static int[][] compute_matrix(long n_value) {
        int size = k + 1;
        if (n_value == 0) {
            int[][] c = new int[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                c[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return c;
        }
        long power = 1;
        int d = 0;
        while (power <= n_value / k) {
            power *= k;
            d++;
        }
        if (n_value == power) {
            return deepCopy(pref.get(d));
        }
        long steps = n_value / power;
        long left = n_value - steps * power;
        int[][] currentMatrix = compute_matrix(0);
        int[][] currentCoef = deepCopy(pref.get(d));
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            currentMatrix = matrix_multiply(currentMatrix, currentCoef);
            currentCoef = shift_matrix(currentCoef);
        }
        int[][] remainingMatrix = compute_matrix(left);
        for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            remainingMatrix = shift_matrix(remainingMatrix);
        }
        return matrix_multiply(currentMatrix, remainingMatrix);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        initialize();
        int[][] result = compute_matrix(n);
        System.out.println(result[k][k]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
